Orb interaction

Motion·by @vanjek·2026-08-30·inspora page·original post

What it is

Voice-assistant orb state machine: one central orb morphs between Idle (thin dim ring), Listening (bright white glow orb), Thinking (dark orb with a rotating crescent arc), Speaking (textured moon-surface orb with alive noise); a left rail lists the states.

Media

Frame-by-frame

0-15%
Idle: small dim ring outline, static; state list shows Idle active.
15-30%
Listening: orb blooms into a large soft white glowing sphere (outer glow halo), gently pulsing scale ~4%.
30-50%
Thinking: orb goes dark with a bright crescent arc sweeping around its limb (rotating highlight, ~1 rev/1.2s) - like a loading moon.
50-75%
Speaking: orb fills with a moon-like crater texture that slowly churns (surface noise scrolls); subtle scale breathing tied to 'speech'.
75-100%
Cycles back through Listening -> Idle; transitions between states are smooth 400-600ms morphs (blur/opacity/scale crossfade), never hard cuts.

Mechanics

trigger
state selection (voice state machine)
elements
orb (layered radial gradients + texture), state rail
properties
orb scale/glow/texture, crescent rotation, pulse amplitude
timing
state morph 400-600ms; listening pulse 1.6s; thinking arc 1.2s/rev; speaking texture continuous
easing
ease-in-out morphs; sine pulses
loop
ambient per state

Build prompt

Build a 4-state voice orb. One 200px circular element composed of layered radial gradients on pure black. Idle: 1.5px white/40 ring, 20% inner fill, still. Listening: fill blooms to a soft white orb (radial white core -> transparent 70%), outer glow via blur(40px) white/35 halo; scale breathes 1->1.04 sine 1.6s. Thinking: orb dims to 15% grey; a crescent highlight (conic-gradient masked to a 20-30% arc, feathered) rotates around the limb at 1 rev/1.2s linear. Speaking: orb surface becomes animated moon texture - fractal noise (fbm) scrolled slowly, contrast-pushed to craters - with amplitude-reactive scale (map audio level 0-1 to scale 0.96-1.08, 80ms attack / 300ms release). Transitions: 500ms ease-in-out crossfade of the layer stack + scale. State rail on the left: list of states, active one white with a dot, others 40% grey.
